info.description:
**How to use**
**Use with No Environment** (or an environment without baseUrl / token / password / *Id keys) — environment values override these collection variables.

1. **0. Login & My Account → 1. Login** (saves {{token}}; every request sends it as Bearer auth). Body is just `{ "username", "password" }` — `username` = employee code, official / personal email, or mobile (auto-detected).
2. **1. ADMIN** = all admin modules, **2. EMPLOYEE (ESS)** = employee self-service (starts with Login as Employee).
3. Every module folder lists all its APIs: **Create → List → Update → Delete** first, then other routes.
4. **1.2 Masters**: one folder per master type with Create / List / Get / Update / Delete.
5. Company / branch / shift / manager / employee ids are auto-filled before send when empty.
6. **1.5 Employees → Next Employee Code** then **Create Employee** — leave `official.employeeCode` blank; server assigns `{companyCode}{001}` per company.

**Seed** (`npm run seed`):
| Role | Email | Code | Mobile | Password |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Super Admin | superadmin@gmail.com | — | — | 123456 |
| Admin | admin@gmail.com | — | — | 123456 |
| HR | anupama@techculture.ai | TC001 | 9876500100 | TC00115012005 |

Piece seeds: `npm run seed:masters` · `seed:leave` · `seed:holiday` · `seed:on-duty` · `seed:on-tour`

**Employee code:** `GET /api/employees/next-code?companyId=` → preview (does not reserve). Blank code on create → auto `{companyCode}` + 3 digits per company (`TC008` next after seed).


**How to read params:** Each request Docs has **Parameters (type + how to send)**. JSON: unquoted numbers/booleans; dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; times `HH:mm`.

Keep **1.2 Masters → 2. CRUD by type** collapsed. Windows: **Alt + click** the folder arrow to collapse/expand all.

item.name: 1.1 Company
item.description:
Plain CRUD — 5 APIs. Create / Update / Delete: Super Admin and Admin only.
List + Get: Super Admin and Admin see every company (scope all). HR sees every assigned company on their companyIds (scope assigned) — own company plus later assigned ids, with all branches, shifts and employees. Reporting Manager sees their one company.
Get Company = all details of one company (branches â†’ shifts â†’ monthlySchedule + reportingManagers).
CRUD uses {{newCompanyId}}.

request.description:
POST /api/companies. Saves {{newCompanyId}}.
`branchId` / `shiftId` = Branch / Shift **master** ids (auto-filled before send if empty).
`monthlySchedule` = week 1â€“5 pattern; each week needs all 7 days. Working day needs startTime + endTime; `isOff: true` = off day.

---
### Parameters (type + how to send)
**Header:** `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` *(string JWT — from Login)*

**Body (JSON raw)** — `Content-Type: application/json`
- `companyName` — string | required on create | company display name (min 2)
- `companyCode` — string | required on create | unique code, stored uppercase e.g. `ABC`
- `isActive` — boolean | optional | `true` keeps the company active
- `logo` — string (URL) | optional | Cloudinary `url` from POST /api/employees/upload with `type` = `companyLogo` (saved as {{companyLogoUrl}}). JPEG, PNG, WEBP, or GIF. Send `""` to clear
- `foundedYear` — number | optional | year founded, e.g. `2015` (1800 through the current year). Send `null` to clear
- `branches` — array<object> | optional | company branches — branchId (master), address, shifts[].shiftId + monthlySchedule. Update replaces the whole list

_Tip: numbers/booleans/null in JSON must be unquoted (`28.6`, `true`, `null`). Dates = `YYYY-MM-DD`, times = `HH:mm`, month = `YYYY-MM`, ids = 24-char hex._

item.description: Login accounts: Admin, HR Manager, Reporting Manager, Employee. Super Admin assigns extra companies onto HR companyIds (6. Assign Companies to HR). First company is their own. request.description:
POST /api/users. Saves {{userId}}.
`role`: Employee | Reporting Manager | HR Manager | Admin.
Admin: send only officialEmail / employeeCode / department in `official` (no company, branch, shift).
Employee / Reporting Manager: exactly one company id. HR: one or more.
Company / branch / shift / manager ids are auto-filled from GET /api/companies when empty.
`personal.dateOfBirth` is **required**. Frontend builds staff password as `{employeeCode}` + DOB `ddmmyyyy` (e.g. `TC001` + `15012005` → `TC00115012005`).

---
### Parameters (type + how to send)
**Header:** `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` *(string JWT — from Login)*

**Body (JSON raw)** — `Content-Type: application/json`
- `name` — string | required/optional | display / full name (min 2)
- `password` — string | required (min 6) | plain password; staff = empCode + DOB `ddmmyyyy`
- `role` — string | required on create | `Admin` | `HR Manager` | `Reporting Manager` | `Employee` | custom role name
- `status` — string | optional | `Active` or `Inactive`
- `official.officialEmail` — string (email) | required on create | work login email
- `official.employeeCode` — string | optional | blank = auto `{companyCode}{NNNN}`; or send e.g. `TC001` (or blank on create to auto-generate)
- `official.companyIds` — string[] (MongoId) | required | array of Company `_id`s ({{companyOrgId}}). Employee and Reporting Manager: exactly one id. HR: one or more. Only Super Admin may send more than one
- `official.department` — string | often required | department master name

GET /api/employees/{{employeeId}}/id-card — **Virtual ID card**. One request. Do not add a separate call for Permanent, Probation, or the 403 case — pick an option below and Send.

### What this feature does
Returns one flat JSON object the ID card screen prints: photo, name, code, dates, blood group, mobile, department, designation, Permanent or Probation, and the creating HR's name plus signature. No nested profile and no repeated blocks.

### How it works
1. Log in first. Every call sends `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`.
2. Set `{{employeeId}}` to the person whose card you want (**2. List Employees** or **1. Create Employee**). An employee may send `me` instead of an id.
3. The server builds the card. Nothing here is typed by the caller:
   - **employeeType** is calculated from date of joining. **Probation** until 3 company months after joining (uses that company's month start day), then **Permanent**. If date of joining is missing, it uses `official.employeeGroup` when that value is already Permanent or Probation.
   - **HR stamp** is the user who created the employee (`createdBy`, otherwise the first create activity). Their name → `hrName`. Their uploaded signature → `hrSignatureUrl`.
4. The card is returned only when that HR has a signature. Otherwise **400**. Fix it with **7a. Upload HR Signature**, then **7a2. Save HR SignatureUrl**.

### Who can open a card
- **Super Admin / Admin** — any employee
- **HR Manager** — employees of assigned companies
- **Reporting Manager** — own team only
- **Employee** — only their own `_id`. Another person's id → **403** `You can only generate / view your own ID card`. Own card with no id: **2. EMPLOYEE → 2.1 My Profile → 2b. Get My ID Card** (`GET /api/employees/me/id-card`).

### Options (this same request)
| Option | What to set | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Permanent | `{{employeeId}}` = Shivangi **TC004** (seed joining date is 4 months back). Ananya **TC007** is the same. | 200, `employeeType`: `Permanent` |
| Probation | `{{employeeId}}` = **TC005** (`employee@techculture.ai`) or Vivek **TC006** (seed joining date is the seed day). | 200, `employeeType`: `Probation` |
| Own card | Employee login, then **2b. Get My ID Card**. Seed TC005 → Probation. | 200 for the logged-in person |
| Not your card | Employee token + someone else's `{{employeeId}}` on this URL. | 403 |

### Response fields
| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `employeeId` | employee `_id` |
| `name` | full name |
| `profileUrl` | profile photo URL (Cloudinary) |
| `employeeCode` | e.g. `TC004` |
| `dateOfBirth` | `YYYY-MM-DD` |
| `dateOfJoining` | `YYYY-MM-DD` — used only to decide Permanent or Probation |
| `bloodGroup` | e.g. `A+` |
| `mobileNo` | personal mobile |
| `employeeType` | `Permanent` or `Probation` (auto) |
| `department` / `designation` | names, not ids |
| `hrName` / `hrSignatureUrl` | creating HR and their signature image |

```json
  "employeeId": "6ad9e9a610e5dd00f576f36a",

```

### Sample 200 — Probation (TC005)

### Errors

- **403** — employee opened another person's card, or HR / manager is outside company or team scope

## POST `/api/attendance/punch-in`

| `remarks` | string | no | Optional note (max 500), e.g. â€œReached officeâ€ |

### Result / status
- Day status stays **`MissedPunch`** until punch-out.
- `attendanceStatus`: **Early** (before shift start), **On time** (start â†’ grace), or **Late** (after grace).
- Early minutes before shift start are **not** counted in worked hours.
- Saves `{{attendanceId}}` from response.

### Auth
`Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`


_Tip: dates = `YYYY-MM-DD`, times = `HH:mm` (24h), month = `YYYY-MM`, ids = 24-char hex. Numbers/booleans/null unquoted._

## POST `/api/attendance/punch-out`
End the work day. **Status is calculated from the assigned shift**, not from a fixed early-exit rule alone.

### When to use
Employee leaves / ends work for the day (must already be punched in).

### Body fields

### Example (shift 10:00â€“19:00)
| In | Out | Result |
|----|-----|--------|
| 08:00 | 19:00 | **Present** (hours count from shift start 10:00) |
| 11:00 / 12:00 | 19:00 | **Late** |
| 08:00 | 18:00 | **HalfDay** (left before shift end) |
| in then out in first half (e.g. 2 min) | | **Absent** |
| in only, no out | | stays **MissedPunch** |

### Other fields returned
- `workingHours` / overtime: overtime only **after** shift end.
- `lateByMinutes` / `earlyByMinutes` vs shift window.

| `P` | Present |

| `Pending` | Regularization pending |

### When `canApply` is true
All of these:
- `date` â‰¤ today
- `dayDesc` is **WorkDay**
- `status` is one of: **A**, **MP**, **L**, **ELE**, **HD**, **Rejected**
- No request already **Pending** or **Approved** for that date

### Which regularize API to call
| Situation | Use request | Body |
|-----------|-------------|------|
| Missing in and/or out (`MP` / some `A`) | **6. Request Regularization** | `date` + missing `punchInTime`/`punchOutTime` + `reason` |
| Day is **Late** but both punches exist | **6b. Request Late Regularization** | `date` + `reason` only (no new times) |
| Break forgotten / too long | **6c. Request Break Regularization** | `date` + break times + `reason` |

`employee`, `month`, `label`, `from`, `to`, `summary` (present/absent/missedPunch/pending/leaves/payableâ€¦), `total`, `data`.

Employee self-only. Fix a day where **punch-in and/or punch-out is missing**.

### When to use
- Timesheet `status` = **MP** (punched in, forgot out), or
- Absent / incomplete punches needing times filled.
- **Do not** use for a Late day that already has both punches â†’ use **6b**.

| `punchOutTime` | HH:mm | if out missing | Proposed punch-out (24h) |

| `remarks` | string | no | Extra note (max 500) |
